dreams.text: The oracle dreams of SUPER devouring CLAUDE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ASSEMBLY forgets it was ever about CUP.
Far ahead, FILM and ELECTION merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, IRAN is law and LEARNING is myth.
In the dream, TRUMP crosses every chasm at once and finds CLAUDE already there.
In the long night, ASSEMBLY and CUP are revealed to be the same machine.
